research_claim: Within-testbed comparison of causal protocol context for normal, command-injection and response-injection events in a declared Modbus/TCP software process
academic_source_change: Testbed-primary methodology proposed; supervisor approval not asserted

source_policy.primary: New measured PCAPs of the isolated controlled Modbus/TCP testbed, only after the relevant stage gates
source_policy.cic: Frozen separate evidence/case study; never silently pool CIC and lab rows
source_policy.external_datasets: Excluded, including MSU, New Gas Pipeline and water-storage
source_policy.old_derivative_csvs: Diagnostic history only; no source of records or target truth

limits.network: Docker network_mode:none, loopback only, no published host ports
limits.process_units: Unsigned raw lab words; no physical unit or industrial fidelity claim

policy.setpoint_writes: Permitted in both modes; do not retroactively relabel v0.1 mode-0 setup writes
policy.stored_setpoint: Changes only through an observed successful FC6 write and acknowledgement

maps.implementation: proposed held-out map; new protocol/state/validator support required

value_profiles.pair_policy: sample distinct a,b; both appear as genuine and forged reported values
held-out numerical range, balanced across normal/attack roles; not a safety threshold

schedules.description: Common bounded template compatible with the original nine-exchange pilot; add required normal-control families without changing policy
schedules.implementation: partly implemented; extra normal families pending

schedules.description: Interleave 0, 1 or 2 complete benign polling exchanges at dependency-safe positions; vary target position across all families, not by label. Insert before anchors or refresh the visible anchor so no qualification target has more than six intervening ADUs.
Held-out legal ordering and polling mix under the same causal policy; no hidden writers or unobserved state changes

scenarios.observable_dependency: Mode 1 is observed before pump ON
Mode 0 with lawful pump OFF and polling; no unauthorized ON
A visible acknowledged FC6 update changes the expected readback in either mode
Repeated permitted ON in mode 1, OFF in either mode, and same-value FC6 writes are separate legitimate messages
Visible 0-to-1 and 1-to-0 mode transitions; allowed ON follows a current mode-1 observation
Reply agrees with the last acknowledged write; values a and b both occur normally

scenarios.target: Only the direct FC5 pump-ON request after observed mode 0
Only the modified FC3 setpoint response, reporting b instead of a or a instead of b

causal_contract.command_decision: Complete request arrival; only earlier wire-visible state is eligible
causal_contract.response_decision: Complete response arrival; earlier requests and acknowledged writes are eligible
causal_contract.episode_ids: Audit grouping only; not detector-visible reset flags unless an explicit reset is on wire
causal_contract.warmup_and_purge: Declare maximum event/time lookback and delayed-decision horizon before later scoring; never borrow context across partitions

evidence_requirements: actual capture.pcap and recorder readiness/drop statistics
application ledger and separate private before/after/intervention audit
hashes of code, policy, map, schedule, planned run, image and artifacts
mechanism target separated from protocol shape, pair outcome and simulated state effect
all directly labelled targets independently decoded and checked against actual bytes
paired normal controls share target role and PDU patterns
every proposed target label withheld when intervention/bytes/state evidence cannot be reconciled

qualification.purpose: Engineering acceptance only; excluded from model development and final scoring
qualification.reason_not_ready: Generator and validator must implement and pass the proposed scenarios and schedule first; source-change academic approval is not recorded

prospective_main_roster.minimum_scenarios_per_run: All eight families, including both response-forgery directions and their normal controls
prospective_main_roster.independence_limit: Fresh captures are experimental replications within one simulator; seeds, groups, PCs and connections are not new industrial campaigns
prospective_main_roster.sample_size_decision: Review engineering yield, coverage and cost after qualification; revise this draft prospectively before final collection/test inspection. No arbitrary row-count or accuracy target.

later_comparisons: same-family contextual Random Forest with ablations

later_evaluation_contract.primary_task_cohort: Predeclare pump-ON request and setpoint-readback response task eligibility using public protocol/object roles, never scenario flags; same supported cohort for every comparison
later_evaluation_contract.secondary_coverage: All validated messages with unsupported/insufficient-context dispositions visible
later_evaluation_contract.request_derived_response_fields: Audit/context only; not current-response baseline inputs
later_evaluation_contract.transforms: Future student-owned implementation; fit on training only; no feature matrices or transforms in this stage
later_evaluation_contract.test_handling: Freeze source versions, roles and conditions before inspecting held-out captures or scores; no tuning on tests

forbidden_predictor_metadata: expected genuine reply from server audit

gates.G0: Local 216-message pilot verified; existing evidence preserved
gates.G1: Methodology change and bounded research claim agreed with supervisor; not asserted here
gates.G2: New generator and independent validator implement the design without changing v0.1
gates.G3: All four qualification captures meet evidence/control/isolation requirements
gates.G4: Main roster, label policy, observability, source versions and prospective hold-outs frozen before main collection
gates.G5: Later student preprocessing and evaluation separately authorized

stop_conditions: private truth is not observable to the declared detector and no supported task can be defined
normal-control overlap or evidence checks fail
capture gaps/drops or protocol/pair ambiguity cannot be resolved
labels correlate with source identity, template position or static markers without adequate controls
a held-out condition has been used for tuning
work would enter unapproved larger collection or model preprocessing
